title: Country Home Relationship Discount on the Operating Lines of Credit Contract Rate
content:
A member whose home is financed by the association through its Rural Home Loans — a Country Home loan — earns a Country Home discount on the contract rate of the Operating Lines of Credit set on the AutoDraft enrolment day.

## Rule

- A Country Home discount of **0.05 points** applies when the member holds a Country Home loan in active status on automatic payment.
- A Country Home discount of **0.025 points** applies when the member holds a Country Home loan in active status not on automatic payment.
- **No** Country Home discount applies when the member holds no Country Home loan in active status.

The loan's status and automatic payment enrolment are read from the member's Rural Home Loans records. The Country Home discount is one of the rate discounts that are added together and capped at the product's discount cap.

## Judgement table

| Country Home loan in active status | On automatic payment | Country Home discount (points) |
|---|---|---|
| Held | Yes | 0.05 |
| Held | No | 0.025 |
| None held (none, or only paid-off loans) | — | None |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A member with an active Country Home 30-Year Fixed loan on automatic payment adds 0.05 points to the line's discounts; if the same loan were not on automatic payment the member would add 0.025 points.
